faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Still unclear? Here are the most common questions.

legal.question: Is downloading YouTube videos legal?
legal.answer: Make sure you have the rights to the content you're re-uploading to TikTok — whether it's your own, used with permission, or openly licensed. We only provide the technical tool; copyright responsibility is on the user.

format.question: Which video formats are supported?
format.answer: Output is always MP4 (H.264 + AAC) per TikTok's requirements. Input can come from almost any public YouTube URL (videos, shorts, finished livestreams).

quality.question: How is the output quality?
quality.answer: We pick the best quality from YouTube (up to 1080p depending on the source) and transcode with FFmpeg presets optimized for TikTok — no watermarks or overlays added.

duration.question: Are there duration limits?
duration.answer: TikTok limits videos to 10 minutes for standard accounts. We recommend trimming to 15-90 seconds for best feed performance.

tiktokAccount.question: Do I need a special TikTok account?
tiktokAccount.answer: No, a regular TikTok account is enough. You only need to authorize the app via OAuth once. Tokens are stored encrypted and auto-refresh when expired.

cost.question: Is it paid?
cost.answer: This tool is open source and self-hostable. The hosted version (if any) will have a free tier for personal use.
